item.title: The Keeper of Fishermen Tales - Destiny Connect
item.description: When it comes to collecting the stories and rich history of Kalk Bay and its fisherpeople, Traci Kwaai aims to tell the real story of this seaside town and ensure their children become custodians of the ocean.

item.title: Speaking Life Into Architecture - Destiny Connect
item.description: During her university years, architect Sumayya Vally challenged the status quo by incorporating different intellectual interests and lived experiences into her practice.

item.title: Breitling Welcomes The Ford Thunderbird To Its Top Time Classic Car Collection - Destiny Connect
item.description: Breitling's best-selling Top Time Classic Cars collection is back and this year they've added the Ford Thunderbird to the line up.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy Series - Enabling Experiences That Open Boundaries - Destiny Connect
item.description: The mobile technology world continues to evolve and the possibilities of what one can achieve with something as handy as a smartphone are now seemingly endless. People can now earn a living and in some cases even gain fame and fortune, all from the palm of their hands.
